summary: Iteration 33 - Frontend Visual Verification of UI Changes. All requested pages verified via screenshots: Login page, Settings page with simplified privacy link, dedicated Privacy Settings page (/settings/privacy) with 3 options, France landmarks page, Visit detail page with visibility chips, and Social/Feed page. All hybrid privacy model UI changes confirmed working.
test_report_links: Screenshots captured during this iteration in .screenshots/ folder
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI changes verified. Frontend routes tested: /explore, /settings, /settings/privacy, /landmarks/france, /visit-detail/visit_ae66f8b6fe54, and Social tab. Login flow works properly with skip onboarding → login → navigate to various pages.

screenshots_captured.1_login_page: Shows Welcome to WanderMark login screen with Email/Password fields, Login button, Sign in with Apple, and signup link
screenshots_captured.2_explore_page: Main app after login showing continents (Europe, Asia, Africa, Americas, Oceania) with visited count
screenshots_captured.3_social_feed: Social tab showing Leaderboard section with top users and Community section with activity items (Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel Tower photos)
screenshots_captured.4_settings_page: Settings page with simplified Privacy section showing 'Privacy & Visibility' link (Default: Public), Notifications section, Account section (Admin Panel, Change Password, Clear Offline Cache, Delete Account), and About section
screenshots_captured.5_privacy_settings: Dedicated Privacy Settings page (/settings/privacy) with 3 privacy options: Public (selected with green checkmark), Friends Only, Private - each with icons and descriptions. Also shows Per-Visit Privacy section and Leaderboard & Points impact section
screenshots_captured.6_france_landmarks: France landmarks page with Your Progress (2/11 landmarks), Community Highlights section (Sacre-Coeur Basilica, Eiffel Tower, Mont Saint-Michel), Community Photos link, and landmark list (Eiffel Tower visited, Louvre Museum, Palace of Versailles, Mont Saint-Michel visited, Arc de Triomphe, Notre-Dame Cathedral) with green 'Visited' FAB
screenshots_captured.7_visit_detail: Visit detail page for Eiffel Tower showing Date (March 5, 2026), Points (+10), Status (Unverified), Visibility section with 3 chip options (Public selected, Friends Only, Private), Quick Notes section, and Share This Visit link
